tests.title: Calcutta claim executes lease bounds without schema-qualifying built-in least/greatest

acceptance.reproduces: The historical defective claim body retained in the Release139 migration chain, before the separately recorded incremental repair, fails SQLSTATE 42883 at pg_catalog.least/greatest before its runtime guard; this is not a claim about the current hosted function
acceptance.accepts: Certified installer removes only the invalid qualifiers; the same valid current-pointer-scoped empty-queue claim returns ok=true, code=PRODUCTION_CALCUTTA_V1_RECALCULATION_EMPTY, and job=null; function owner, ACL, SECURITY DEFINER and config remain byte-semantically unchanged

tests.title: Net Skins read, claim and official-result normalization use callable PostgreSQL built-ins

acceptance.reproduces: Actual frozen participant read and claim fail SQLSTATE 42883 with invalid pg_catalog.least/greatest qualifiers
acceptance.accepts: Exact fixed participant read returns ok=true; the same valid current-pointer-scoped empty-queue claim returns ok=true, code=PRODUCTION_NET_SKINS_V1_RECALCULATION_EMPTY, and job=null; the malformed normalizer check still fails closed; function owner, ACL, SECURITY DEFINER and config stay unchanged

proofLayers: real PostgreSQL 17 frozen read and claim invocations
malformed claim/normalizer fail-closed checks after expression repair

tests.title: Canonical score avoids irrelevant historical Calcutta compatibility evaluation

acceptance.fixture: 7450 accumulated Calcutta jobs at 10x history; zero eligible late-R3 compatibility receipts
acceptance.oldFailure: Historical migration 97 compatibility function reaches a failure-injection sentinel in the consumed-history fingerprint function during an actual canonical score mutation
acceptance.futureExpectedBehavior: Release139 migration120 avoids that irrelevant work; a real ACCEPTED score is returned and gross/strokes/net remain identical after reinstalling the corrected function

limitations: Proves the zero-eligible-receipt branch; eligible recovery receipts remain additional required coverage.
Local rollback samples do not establish hosted or durable-commit latency.
Current-tournament synchronous derived work remains; Phase1 does not redesign it.
